official.deadline_note: TSLS publishes no closing date for this scheme on the scheme page or in the 2027 TSLS Scholarship Policies Handbook. The TSLS Apply portal is live for registration and TSLS opens applications ahead of each academic year; for the 2026 academic year round, TSLS announced a 31 January deadline (TSLS news, 7 January 2026) after applications opened on 5 December 2025.
official.application_cycle: 2027 TSLS Scholarship Policies Handbook cycle (handbook published September 2026 and featured on tsls.com.fj); applications open ahead of each academic year
official.status_note: The TSLS Apply portal is live and the scheme page carries an 'Apply Now' link; TSLS registers applicants ahead of each academic year and assesses submissions once final offer letters are issued. No closing date for the current round is published.
official.tuition_coverage_note: 2027 TSLS Scholarship Policies Handbook, Executive Summary: 'This existing scheme is being revamped to partially support students except the Tuition Fee, which partner Universities in Australia and New Zealand shall bear.'

Overseas student health cover fee for sponsored students only
Establishment allowance (one-off payment at the beginning of the programme) at a maximum rate of AUD/NZD $3500
Excess baggage allowance at a maximum rate of AUD/NZD $300

Secure an offer letter or candidature confirmation letter from an eligible institution in Australia or New Zealand for full-time studies unless determined by the Service or arranged with the employer
Demonstrate the direct and applied relevance of the research study towards Fiji's workforce needs and development
Be less than 50 years of age from the time of application
Not be an existing TSLS sponsored student or graduate (on active bond service) or sponsored through any other agency

Demonstrate the direct and applied relevance of the research study towards Fiji's workforce needs and development

Demonstration of the direct and applied relevance of the research study towards Fiji's workforce needs and development (research proposal)
Evidence of Fiji citizenship and of ordinary residence in Fiji for at least three (3) years

Signed Provisional Offer Letter and Bond Form uploaded on the portal landing page to accept an award
selection_criteria: TSLS assesses applications online against the set criteria; all applications go through an extensive review and TSLS's decision is final and cannot be appealed
Awards are allocated based on academic ranking, from highest to lowest, until the designated quota for each scheme is reached, except when selection involves interviews or aptitude tests
Applicants who do not secure a place within their preferred scheme's quota may be offered alternative scholarship options
Direct and applied relevance of the research study towards Fiji's workforce needs and development
coverage: Living costs: living allowance at a minimum AUD/NZD of $32,000 or at a local market rate, plus a one-off establishment allowance at the beginning of the programme (maximum AUD/NZD $3500)
Travel: Economy Class yearly return airfare and excess baggage allowance (maximum AUD/NZD $300)
Fees: Visa Fees up to $3000 FJD and overseas student health cover fee for sponsored students only
Research costs: field grant of up to AUD/NZD $3,000, only where the student is required and approved to undertake field surveys for primary data collection
Tuition fee is not paid by TSLS under this scheme - partner universities in Australia and New Zealand bear the tuition fee
official.application_route: Apply online via the TSLS Apply portal (apply.tsls.com.fj): register, complete the online form with all mandatory fields and uploads, and submit for online assessment; the outcome is notified through the portal
official.study_mode: Full-time (unless determined by the Service or arranged with the employer)
official.citizenship_residency: Must be a Fiji citizen and ordinarily a resident of Fiji for at least three (3) years before the award commencement date, unless determined by the Service
official.international_eligibility: Not open to international students - Fiji citizenship is a mandatory criterion; existing TSLS sponsored students or graduates on active bond service, and students sponsored through any other agency, are excluded
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Research must fall within the scheme's 12 priority disciplines (Medical and Health Services; Engineering Services; Climate Change/Environmental Science; Marine Science; Forestry; Public Policy and Analysis; Economic Modelling and Policies; Public Financing; Inclusive Education; Information Technology Services; Social Science; Border Security) and be undertaken at an eligible institution - 10 listed Australian universities (CQUniversity Australia, Griffith, Monash, QUT, Swinburne, University of Newcastle, UNSW, University of Queensland, RMIT, Western Sydney), with the 2027 Handbook also allowing eligible institutions in Australia or New Zealand; additional universities may be added following review and approval by TSLS
official.research_requirement: PhD-level research with direct and applied relevance to Fiji's workforce needs and development; sponsorship is reviewed each academic term against a yearly progressive report
official.description: TSLS describes the Cost Sharing Overseas PhD Scheme as an existing scheme being revamped to partially support students, with the tuition fee borne by partner universities in Australia and New Zealand. It offers 5 awards for full-time PhD study in Fiji's priority disciplines, pairing a living allowance with travel, visa, health cover, establishment and field-survey support.
official.region: Oceania (study in Australia or New Zealand; awarding body Fiji)
official.program_type: Government scholarship administered by the Tertiary Scholarships and Loans Service (TSLS), a statutory body established in 2014 under the Tertiary Scholarship and Loans Act 2014, Ministry of Education, Government of Fiji

applicant_utility.summary: This is a cost-shared PhD placement rather than a full scholarship: TSLS pays a minimum living allowance of AUD/NZD $32,000 (or local market rate), yearly economy-class return airfare, visa fees up to $3000 FJD, overseas student health cover, a one-off establishment allowance up to AUD/NZD $3500 and conditional field-survey money, while the partner university carries the tuition. Only five awards exist for the whole country and they are ranked by academic performance until the quota fills, so you need a full-time offer or candidature from one of the ten named Australian universities in hand before you apply, with research framed around a documented Fiji workforce need. Expect a bond of one year of service per year sponsored, and note that any award offer must be accepted within three days.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Fiji citizens under 50 holding a full-time PhD offer or candidature from a listed Australian university in one of the twelve priority disciplines, whose research maps directly onto a national workforce or development gap.
application_readiness_checklist: Secure the final (not provisional) offer or candidature confirmation letter from an eligible university before submitting - TSLS will not assess provisional offers
Pre-scan every supporting document to pdf, png or jpg under 5MB each, and register on the TSLS Apply portal with a personal Gmail, Yahoo or Hotmail address
Write the research-relevance case so a non-specialist assessor can tie it to a named Fiji workforce or development need within one of the twelve priority disciplines
Have bank account or mobile wallet details, highest educational attainment and income details ready to enter in the portal
Confirm you are not currently TSLS-sponsored or serving an active bond, that no other agency sponsors you, and that you will be under 50 at application
Monitor the portal landing page for status and be ready to sign and upload the Provisional Offer Letter and Bond Form within three days of any offer
common_rejection_risks: Missing the quota: with only five awards nationwide, ranking below other applicants means no award or an offer of an alternative scheme
Applying on a provisional offer letter, or submitting before the final offer or candidature confirmation is in hand
An incomplete application - TSLS blocks submission until all mandatory fields are complete, and late or incomplete applications are not assessed
Research that does not visibly connect to a priority discipline or to Fiji's workforce needs and development
Being 50 or older at application, being on an active TSLS bond, or holding sponsorship from any other agency
Providing false information, which is a serious offence under the False Information Act 2016
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: TSLS does not pay tuition - the partner university bears it under its cost-sharing arrangement - so any fee the university's arrangement does not cover falls to you. You also fund anything above the published caps (excess baggage beyond AUD/NZD $300, field surveys beyond AUD/NZD $3,000 or surveys not approved for a field grant), and because TSLS no longer pays hostel accommodation directly, away-campus accommodation must be met from your own allowance. Declining the bond means repaying the total amount disbursed towards your studies.
document_audit: Every upload must be pdf, png or jpg and under 5MB - oversized or wrongly formatted files are the most common avoidable failure
The offer letter must be final; provisional study offer letters are not accepted for processing
Portal registration must use your own email address (Gmail, Yahoo or Hotmail), not a shared or institutional one
Submission cannot be completed until all mandatory fields are filled; the only published exceptions are Year 13 results and the final programme offer letter
Acceptance requires a signed Provisional Offer Letter and Bond Form uploaded on the landing page within three days of the offer date
alerts: Award offers lapse if not accepted within three days of the date stated in the offer letter

Bond exposure: the handbook's bond formula table lists cost-sharing awards from 2026 onwards as one year of service per year sponsored, and TSLS states that declining the bond means repaying the total amount disbursed
Sponsorship for this scheme is reviewed each academic term against a yearly progressive report - falling behind risks probation, reduced payments or suspension
Enrol in a full academic load: allowances are otherwise paid pro-rata
The eligible-institution list can change ('additional universities may be added following review and approval by TSLS'), so confirm your university's current status before applying
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Register on the TSLS Apply portal, complete the online form with all mandatory fields and uploads, submit for online assessment, then track the outcome on the portal landing page; if awarded, accept the offer and bond within three days and TSLS issues the confirmation letter.
